In [[3962 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was '''engaged''' by [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] in the [[Vena system/Legends|Vena system]]<ref name="Atlas" /> located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Nojic sector/Legends|Nojic sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> as part of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], an ongoing conflict between the two groups. The battle took place because the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were advancing through a number of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in an attempt to conquer the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. This assault, called [[Mandalorian Triumph]], brought the Mandalorian forces from their territory [[Battle of the Nazzri system (Mandalorian Wars)|through]] the [[Nazzri system/Legends|Nazzri system]], which they took before launching their attack on the Vena [[Star system/Legends|system]] and winning there as well. Afterward, the Mandalorian forces passed through the [[Japrael system/Legends|Japrael system]], where they had [[First battle of Onderon (Mandalorian Wars)|taken]] the planet of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] earlier in the war,<ref name="Atlas" /> to rendezvous with forces on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], that planet's moon.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The combined army then [[Battle of the Ambria system|claimed]] the [[Ambria system/Legends|Ambria system]] before continuing Coreward.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Vena system was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Atlas" />
